name: LBNCo
summary: The Local Broadband Network Company — builder/operator of open-access fibre-to-the-premises networks for multi-dwelling units and residential estates; billed as Australia's first FTTH operator. PE-backed (ROC Partners MBO) then acquired by Uniti for $100m (2019); brand retired when Uniti consolidated its wholesale business into OptiComm (2020).

events.details: >20 years' experience in FTTH (legal profile); connecting households to its private network since 2007.
LBNCo brand retired when Uniti adopted OptiComm as its wholesale/infrastructure market brand.
